facts.why: An invented hotel name for the election-night venue. It claims nothing about the plot, and the film has David's concession night in a hotel.
The cast list names Charlie Traynor, David's campaign manager, and the transcript has David introducing him as his campaign chairman.

facts.text: from the cart beside the bus stop
facts.why: No nut cart appears anywhere. What the sources show is David catching his bus and meeting Elise again on it.
facts.fix: for the bus ride where they meet again

facts.text: the date they're not supposed to have
facts.why: David and Elise spend a day out together after he finds her again, and Richardson says he was never meant to see her a second time.
There is no party. Elise is at rehearsals with Cedar Lake Contemporary Ballet, where David chases her down.
facts.fix: Elise's rehearsal at the dance company

vibe.verdict: A neat election night banquet built on the bathroom and coffee-spill moments, but the Bureau's hats and doors barely appear.
